name: wine32-cli
description:
wine32-cli is a portable, lightweight 32-bit Wine runtime environment configured specifically for running 32-bit Windows command-line applications and utilities on modern 64-bit Linux distributions.

Features:
- Pre-configured 32-bit Wineprefix for running x86 Windows console software
- Operates seamlessly without installing multilib 32-bit library dependencies on the host system
- Ideal for legacy Windows compilers, decompilers, assemblers, and command-line tools
- Fast execution with direct terminal input and output forwarding
- Self-contained and portable across all modern Linux distributions
